{"metadata":{"description":"Keeps edited dsh plugins as local git repos; deploys committed snapshots via atomic symlink swap.","id":"gh:1407225023","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-local-plugins","slug":"ishanshmalviya5/dsh-local-plugins","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Keeps edited dsh plugins as local git repos; deploys committed snapshots via atomic symlink swap."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-local-plugins"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**Customize any dsh plugin — even a built-in one — without losing your changes when things update, b"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"reak or get reinstalled.**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## What you can do with it"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"| You want to… | You click | You get |"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"| **Fix or tweak a plugin and keep the fix** | **+ Add → Migrate**, edit, **Commit**, **Apply** | Yo"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"ur change runs in dsh and survives updates and reinstalls |
| **Take the author's new release withou"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"t losing your tweaks** | **Update** | The new version *plus* your changes; if both touched the same "},{"id":"p6s4","text":"lines you are asked, and nothing breaks meanwhile |
| **Go back** when a change misbehaves | **Deplo"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"y older commit…** | The earlier version, instantly |
| **Customize a built-in dsh feature** (for exa"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"mple a model provider) | the same steps, on a built-in plugin | Your version runs; **Unlink** gives "},{"id":"p6s7","text":"the original back |
| **Let an AI agent change a plugin safely** | **Work on it** | An agent opens i"},{"id":"p6s8","text":"nside that plugin's folder with the context filled in; it can't switch anything on — only you can |
"},{"id":"p6s9","text":"| **Keep your history tidy so updates stay easy** | **Squash my changes** | An agent collapses all y"},{"id":"p6s10","text":"our commits into one on top of the original release; a backup branch is made first and it checks the"},{"id":"p6s11","text":" code is unchanged |
| **Pin a dependency to a newer version** | **Dependency overrides → Apply over"},{"id":"p6s12","text":"ride** | The override is saved, deployed and checked: you see a ✔ only when it is really installed |"},{"id":"p6s13","text":"
| **Recover after dsh was upgraded or reinstalled** | **Reapply all** | Your customizations are swi"},{"id":"p6s14","text":"tched back on |
| **Try one exact version** | **+ Add**, `name@1.2.3` (or `…#v1.2.0`) | That version"},{"id":"p6s15","text":", and it stays put |
| **See what you changed versus the original** | look at the card | "3 files ch"},{"id":"p6s16","text":"anged vs original", and what is running right now |

| **Conflict** | an update needs your decision about some"},{"id":"p32s4","text":" files | **Finish update** or **Abort** |

| Windows | ❌ Not supported — it says so and doesn't start |"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"Built and tested against **dsh 0.2.0-rc.2**. Upgrading from version 0.1 needs nothing from you: your"},{"id":"p36s2","text":" plugins stay exactly as they are (details in the CHANGELOG)."}],"truncated":true}
